_comment: Copy to agent_view.config.json and edit. All fields optional. This file is a template and is safe to commit; the real config is gitignored.
_relay_comment: Leave relay empty for LOCAL-ONLY (nothing leaves this machine). Set it to push events to a VPS so you can watch from a phone / another computer. The relay piece is opt-in and documented in README.md — not built by default.
_customer_profiles_comment: F4: 'koristi profile kupaca' toggle. When true (the default), the ticket-reader injects the learned per-creator profile into every read and summarises it (one Gemini call) at ticket close; when false, the deterministic learning (history[]) still runs for free, but no profile rides the prompt and no AI summary call happens. Flip it from the HUD (POST /api/tickets/profiles-toggle) or here.
_monitor_comment: F5 (decision 2026-08-19): the VPS monitor URL + read-only MCP token, read by monitor_client.config(). A production credential, but read-only and this is a private repo, sole access — so it is tracked like the Gemini key. Leave both empty for 'not configured' (the Production tab shows a notice).
_mail_accounts_comment: F5: mail-account METADATA only (id/name/email/host/port/ssl/user) — NEVER a password or pass_enc. The DPAPI-encrypted password stays in the gitignored agent_view.mail.config.json, per machine; run agent_view/seed_tracked_config.py once to migrate an existing local account's metadata here.
